classification.difficultyReason: Combine boundary segments and derive missing sloping sides using Pythagoras.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of each of the figures shown below. You may assume that anything that looks like a right-angle is a right-angle.

spec.description: Three-level orthogonal staircase with only its overall height and base labelled.
spec.mathematics: Overall height 12 m and width 20 m; intermediate step lengths are unspecified.
spec.answerVisibility: No derived lengths or answer shown.

answer.worked:
The horizontal boundary segments total $2\times20$ m, and the vertical boundary segments total $2\times12$ m.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2\times20+2\times12\\P&=64\,\mathrm{m}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two rectangular notches; matching single ticks on five top horizontal segments and four notch vertical segments.
spec.mathematics: Base 30 m, outer height 18 m; all nine ticked segments have equal length.
spec.answerVisibility: Common segment length is not supplied.

answer.worked:
The five equal horizontal segments total $30$ m, so each ticked segment is $30\div5=6$ m. The four notch sides also have length $6$ m.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2\times30+2\times18+4\times6\\P&=120\,\mathrm{m}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right trapezium with an unlabelled sloping right side.
spec.mathematics: Height 6 cm, top 4 cm, base 10 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: No auxiliary triangle or calculated side shown.

answer.worked:
The sloping side has horizontal difference $10-4=6$ cm and vertical difference $6$ cm. By Pythagoras,
$$\begin{align*}s&=\sqrt{6^2+6^2}\\s&=6\sqrt2\,\mathrm{cm}.\\P&=6+4+10+6\sqrt2\\P&=(20+6\sqrt2)\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Five-sided outline with a diagonal at the upper left.
spec.mathematics: Left height 9 m, right height 6 m, base 16 m, upper horizontal side 12 m.

answer.worked:
The diagonal has horizontal difference $16-12=4$ m and vertical difference $9-6=3$ m.
$$\begin{align*}s&=\sqrt{4^2+3^2}\\s&=5\,\mathrm{m}.\\P&=9+16+6+12+5\\P&=48\,\mathrm{m}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: U-shaped orthogonal outline; arm widths and inner horizontal length are unspecified.
spec.mathematics: Outer heights 8 cm and 5 cm, left inner descent 6 cm, base 29 cm.

answer.worked:
The inner horizontal edge is $8-6=2$ cm above the base, so the right inner side is $5-2=3$ cm. All horizontal boundary segments total $2\times29$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2\times29+8+6+3+5\\P&=80\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with a dashed diagonal from upper-left to lower-right.
spec.mathematics: Base 14 cm, right height 8 cm, dashed diagonal 10 cm; top and left slope unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: Both unknown boundary lengths are omitted.

answer.worked:
Using the right-hand triangle, the top length is
$$\begin{align*}t&=\sqrt{10^2-8^2}\\t&=6\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$
The left sloping side has horizontal difference $14-6=8$ cm and vertical difference $8$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}s&=\sqrt{8^2+8^2}\\s&=8\sqrt2\,\mathrm{cm}.\\P&=14+8+6+8\sqrt2\\P&=(28+8\sqrt2)\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$
